scope: Recovered hydrostatic workbook audit and bounded locomotive matching study, not complete Phase 3N
engine_budget_trial_meaning: Available power before the assumed 10 kW traction-auxiliary allowance. 35 and 45 kW are arbitrary installed-power sensitivities, not Kubota ratings or derating factors. 55.4 kW is published gross intermittent power, not accepted net continuous power.

assumption_classification.wheel_and_gearing: Inherited trials, not selected hardware or geometry
assumption_classification.efficiencies: Inherited constant assumptions; invalid as verified stall/low-speed/temperature maps
assumption_classification.running_resistance: 0.004 is a generic Danfoss selection-guide example for steel rails, not site evidence; other values are analyst sensitivity inputs
assumption_classification.extra_resistance: Aggregate curve/wind/bearing/brake-drag probe, not a curve law, measured force or added grade
assumption_classification.auxiliary_power: Unallocated lump retained from workbook. Needs compressor/charge/fan/electrical duty reconciliation; no hotel HVAC included.
assumption_classification.adhesive_mass: Independent probes; 14,500 kg locomotive-plus-hotel mass cannot be assumed fully driven
assumption_classification.cooling: 80 C oil inlet and 30/40/46 C cooling air are trial conditions, not selected setpoints or Nevada design weather
